mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods with UNRATE > 8.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and PAYEMS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a sustained increase in federal funds rate above 4.0% compresses corporate borrowing costs and reduces equity valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the tightening trigger, or Rank IC for trigger condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic growth that supports corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of periods with rising INDPRO, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 700,000 units signal weak residential construction and declining consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of periods with HOUST < 700.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In strong economic expansion, quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.0% signals sustained demand momentum that supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with GDPC1 growth > 2.0%, or Rank IC for growth signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) indicates stagflation, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of high CPIAUCSL and high UNRATE fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
